litw-template-title: Creativity and Diversity in Social Media Advertisements
litw-study-subtitle: Make sure to quickly present your study and tell participants what they will get out of it!
litw-study-description-p1: Welcome! You're about to take a test on Lab in the Wild. You will see several ads and rate them based on your first impressions. We'll tell you if you prefer ads designed with AI support or without AI support.
litw-study-description-p2: This test will take less than 10 minutes.
litw-irb2-header: Before we get started, here are a few things you should know...
litw-irb2-q1: Why we are doing this research?
litw-irb2-a1-p1: We want to understand people's perceptions of advertisements, particularly in terms of visual appeal, creativity, and whether ads encourage people to click. Additionally, we aim to explore if ads designed with the support of AI are perceived differently from those created without AI assistance.
litw-irb2-a1-p2: You can then see how your results reveal traits about how your rating decisions! Altogether, this will no more than 5 minutes.
litw-irb2-q2: What you will have to do?
litw-irb2-a2: You will view several advertisements, similar to those you might encounter on social media. For each ad, you’ll be asked to rate: how visually appealing it is, how likely you would be to click on it, and how creative you feel the design is. Please see an example preview to the right.
litw-irb2-q3: Do I have to be in this study?
litw-irb2-a3: Your participation in this study is completely voluntary, and you may refuse to participate or withdraw at any time without penalty or loss of benefits to which you may otherwise be entitled.
litw-irb2-a4-p2: This study has been approved by the University of Washington Human Subjects Division. If you want to discuss this study and its' protocol with someone who is not part of the study team, you can contact the Human Subjects Division Office at: hsdinfo@uw.edu or 206.543.0098. (for international calls include the US Calling Code: +1-206-543-0098).
litw-irb2-a4-p1: Your responses will remain anonymous. We do not collect any personally identifiable information, and this survey will take approximately 5 minutes to complete.
litw-irb2-consent: I agree to participate in this research.
litw-irb-subheader-1: You're about to take a test on LabintheWild. Your contribution to our research allows us to learn more about cognitive differences around the world. The results from your test will also tell you something about yourself!
litw-irb-subheader-2: Please read the following information carefully before proceeding.
litw-irb-body-0-p1: Why we are doing this research?
litw-irb-body-0-p2: We are trying to learn what people from different cultural and demographic backgrounds think about cats.
litw-irb-body-1-p1: What you will have to do?
litw-irb-body-1-p2: You will be shown a series of pictures of cats. You will need to indicate which cat you prefer among those shown.
litw-irb-body-2-p1: What you will get out of it?
litw-irb-body-2-p2: We will give you feedback on how your results compare to those of other participants. The final results from this experiment will be posted on our blog page. The experiment is not designed to benefit you, but you may enjoy it and enjoy comparing your results with those of other participants.
litw-irb-body-3-p2: We will not ask you for your name. Any data that we collect will be securely stored on our servers.
litw-irb-body-5-p2: If you have questions about this research, you may contact Professor Buttons, Head of Feline Research, University of Washington.
litw-irb-body-final: If you have questions about your rights as a research participant, or wish to obtain information, ask questions or discuss any concerns about this study with someone other than the researcher(s), please contact the Unversity of Washington IRB.
litw-irb-consent: By ticking this box, you are agreeing to be in the study. Be sure that questions you have about the study have been answered and that you understand what you are being asked to do. You may contact the researcher if you think of a question later. You are free to leave the experiment at any time, and refusing to be in the experiment or stopping participation will involve no penalty or loss of benefits to which you are otherwise entitled.
litw-irb-warning: You must check the box to continue.

litw-adsurvey-question1: Please rate this social media advertisement on the following dimensions to the best of your ability:
litw-adsurvey-question1-1: If I saw this advertisement on social media, I would click it.
litw-adsurvey-question1-2: I believe this advertisement is visually appealing.
litw-adsurvey-question1-3: I believe this advertisement's design is creative.
